en.headline: Tung Chung Block 2 concrete samples fail contractual tests
en.dek: Housing Authority orders suspension of pouring and core tests after individual samples from the public housing project in Area 42 fall short of requirements.
body: The Housing Authority said on Tuesday that individual concrete test samples from Block 2 of a public housing project under construction in Tung Chung Area 42 had failed to meet contractual requirements, the latest quality issue at the site.

The authority immediately instructed the contractor to suspend concrete pouring at the relevant locations and to extract concrete cores from the affected structural components for compressive strength testing by an accredited independent laboratory.

Blocks 3, 4 and 5 of the same project had already been flagged for further review and testing after routine cube strength checks between late August and early September. The first batch of 12 core results from Block 5, representing about 17 per cent of the total, showed strengths 23 to 66 per cent above the standard and complied with design and contractual requirements.

Full core compressive strength results are expected on 25 September. The authority said the engineering team will decide whether a formal review of the structural components is needed once all results are in; if so, the contractor must submit a remedial proposal for approval before pouring can resume. The Housing Authority currently expects only a minor impact on the project’s overall progress.

zh.headline: 東涌第2座公屋混凝土樣本未達合約要求
zh.dek: 房委會指東涌42區公營房屋項目第2座個別混凝土樣本未達標，已即時指示承建商暫停相關位置澆灌並抽取芯樣化驗。
body: 房屋委員會周二表示，東涌第42區興建中公營房屋項目第2座個別混凝土測試樣本未能符合合約要求，是該地盤最新發現的質量問題。
房委會已即時指示承建商暫停相關位置的混凝土澆灌，並按合約標準從相關結構構件抽取混凝土芯樣本，交由認可獨立實驗室進行抗壓強度測試。
同一項目第3、4及5座早前已因8月底至9月初的恒常方塊強度測試結果，被要求進一步審視及測試。第5座首批12個芯樣結果（約佔總數17%）顯示強度高出標準23%至66%，符合設計及合約要求。
全面芯樣抗壓強度測試結果預計9月25日公布。工程團隊會在取得全部結果後，決定是否需要檢討相關結構構件的混凝土強度；若需檢討，承建商須提交補救方案經審批後，方可恢復澆灌。房委會目前預期事件對項目整體進度影響輕微。
